coverage.evidence: PlatformTemplateHelpers.cs:37-45 registers 25 rows under namespace platform (4 connected + 5 link + 3 live + 6 viewer + 3 totals + 4 seed, from PlatformConnectedHelpers.cs:17-55, PlatformLinkHelpers.cs:19-41, PlatformLiveHelpers.cs:19-48, PlatformViewerHelpers.cs:20-65, PlatformTotalsHelpers.cs:19-29, PlatformSeedHelpers.cs:19-46); OfPlatform forms take exactly one argument (PlatformRow.cs:76-92); PlatformNames.Find matches key or name, trimmed and ignoring case (PlatformNames.cs:29-33); an unknown name or a wrong argument count returns null, so the token stays as written (PlatformRow.cs:89-97).

Empty text is PlatformText.Nothing (PlatformText.cs:20); the list separator ', ' and the part separator ' · ' (PlatformText.cs:22-24); counts use N0 in the channel culture with en-US as fallback (PeopleText.cs:24, NumberCulture.cs:22-35, TemplateRenderScope.cs:37); isLive gives true/false (PlatformLiveHelpers.cs:40-48, PeopleText.cs:21); live.count is empty with no links, otherwise a count (PlatformLiveHelpers.cs:35-38); share is rounded to a whole percent (PlatformViewerHelpers.cs:60-63); links drop https:// (PlatformNames.cs:43-54); order is Twitch, Kick, YouTube (DbPlatformDirectory.cs:54, PlatformNames.cs:21-26); chat totals count from the go-live date in the channel zone to now (PlatformData.cs:181-191) and give 0 for a connected platform with no summary (PlatformTotalsHelpers.cs:47-53); followers are empty when Twitch is not connected or the read fails (PlatformData.cs:165-175).

Channel rows use TemplateHelperContexts.Standard, which is every context except Viewer (PlatformRow.cs:47-48, TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22), and the full set is Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord, Webhook (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:32-40); the three platform.user rows use WithTriggerViewer and are event-scoped, and platform.event uses WithTriggerViewerAndDiscord (PlatformSeedHelpers.cs:19-46, TemplateHelperContexts.cs:32-45); in viewer text a helper outside the Viewer context resolves to null, so it stays as written (TemplateResolver.cs:123-127,155-156).

A per-platform viewer count needs IsLive and a non-null Viewers (PlatformViewerHelpers.cs:68-78); the Kick fallback gives live with no count (PlatformStatusReader.cs:112-113), and YouTube can be live with a null count (PlatformStatusReader.cs:89-97); total, breakdown, share and top use only live platforms that have a count (PlatformText.cs:32-39), and total is empty when none has one (PlatformViewerHelpers.cs:28-30).

platform.user, platform.user.name and platform.user.icon read the user.provider seed, and platform.event reads the provider seed (PlatformData.cs:88-91, PlatformSeedHelpers.cs:20-45); a chat command seeds both from the message's platform (ChatMessageHandler.cs:1862-1863); an empty seed returns null, so the token stays as written (PlatformSeedHelpers.cs:49-50, PlatformNames.cs:29-33); the icons are purple, green and red dots (PlatformNames.cs:23-25); user.provider is seeded only when the event carries user.id (TemplateSubject.cs:48-56).

reader_answers.evidence:
The dot-suffixed keys platform.link.

, platform.viewers.

and platform.followers.twitch exist (PlatformLinkHelpers.cs:44-53, PlatformViewerHelpers.cs:68-78); isLive, title, viewers.share, messages.stream and chatters.stream are OfPlatform rows that take a colon argument (PlatformLiveHelpers.cs:40, PlatformConnectedHelpers.cs:47, PlatformViewerHelpers.cs:48, PlatformTotalsHelpers.cs:41); the name matches key or name ignoring case (PlatformNames.cs:29-33).

Links need a connection (PlatformData.cs:95-98); viewers, title and the YouTube live link need IsLive (PlatformViewerHelpers.cs:74-77, PlatformConnectedHelpers.cs:52, PlatformLinkHelpers.cs:27-30); the contexts are Standard (TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22, TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:32-40).

Empty is the Nothing default (PlatformText.cs:20); isLive gives false (PeopleText.cs:21); live.count gives 0 when platforms are connected (PlatformLiveHelpers.cs:36-38); an unknown name or no argument gives null, so the token stays as written (PlatformRow.cs:89-97).

platform.link.kick and platform.viewers.kick exist (PlatformLinkHelpers.cs:20, PlatformViewerHelpers.cs:34); Kick can be live without a count (PlatformStatusReader.cs:59-66,112-113); default renders the fallback when the value is blank (DefaultTemplateHelpers.cs:33-39).
